title: The document save reads the store's erase mark as the batch starts, not an erase the caller hands it
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (R5 PR 2): bulkSaveDocuments, which read this.shownErase as the batch started, had no production caller and left the store (copy for tests in widget-src/src/testing/bulk-save.ts). The live document save is the upload's saveUploadThrough, which takes the erase from the flow's saving state, read at the press on Save (see H18). Was: storage/roadmap-store.ts:428 const erase = this.shownErase
